name: red-04-final-tests-naive-kill-by-marker
purpose: RED re-taken on the FINAL tests (red-01..03 were taken on the first test revision, before GREEN exposed the libuv job cascade and the conhost.exe children, and stay archived unchanged). The full U004 suite (hermetic fake-OS tests, adapter tests, real adapter tests, real marked Node tree with look-alikes) against the archived NAIVE implementation in marker mode: find the tree by a marker in command lines, kill every match and every recorded pid without re-verifying identity. Expected: behavioral failures. The production modules tree.cjs and windows.cjs are not loaded (U004_RED_IMPL selects the naive file).
